business_summary: UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of software products in China. The company offers intelligent computing solutions, including multimodal training and propulsion fusion, inference all-in-one machine, and enlightenment box. It also provides enlightenment platform products, such as enlightened intelligent agent platform to integrate internal information, processes, and large models; and enlightenment big model operations management system to simplify the training, development, deployment, and maintenance of models. In addition, the company offers smart applications comprising enlightenment multimodal content production platform, a generative AI content production platform; enlightenment AI knowledge base question answering system, a document-based digital human question-answering system; AIGC content security risk control platform, an application that enables security across the processes of large models; and virtual power plant intelligent control platform, a platform for resource aggregation, monitoring and alarm, predictive analysis, market trading, regulation and operation, and operation management. It serves government affairs, energy, media, security, culture, finance, and education industries. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Ucap Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd. in September 2018. UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
